entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The main person seated in the front row, with short light-brown hair, wearing a black top and light-green earmuff headphones, with a dark gray-green safety harness covering the shoulders and back.

entities.name: aircraft cockpit
entities.identification: The interior of the aircraft cockpit surrounding Person A, with light-colored inner walls, black window frames and support tubes, an instrument panel, a red recessed panel, and hanging cables.

entities.name: front-row seat
entities.identification: The visible portion of a light gray-beige cushioned seat behind Person A at the bottom edge of the image.

entities.name: sky and clouds
entities.identification: The blue sky and white band-shaped and sheet-like clouds above the horizon outside the windows.

entities.name: field
entities.identification: Expanses of field outside the windows, composed of adjoining yellow-brown and green plots.

entities.name: forest belt
entities.identification: Dark green-gray belts and patches of woodland with winding edges between the fields.

entities.name: field road
entities.identification: The narrow, light-colored roads between the plots outside the windows, including the longer diagonal straight road segment in the left window.

entities.name: building complex
entities.identification: Small, scattered clusters of rooftops among the fields outside the windows, some of which are light-colored rectangles.
